story.iWant: a dedicated AI Generator page with organized tabs
story.soThat: I can easily navigate between transcription, generation, and history
story.tasks: - Task 1: Add AI Generator button to sidebar (AC: 1, 2) - Task 2: Create AI Generator page container component (AC: 3, 7, 8) - Task 3: Implement tab navigation system (AC: 4, 5, 6) - Task 4: Create placeholder panel components (AC: 4) - Task 5: Add UI state management for AI Generator visibility (AC: 3, 7) - Task 6: Implement page routing/navigation (AC: 3, 7) - Task 7: Style and theme the AI Generator page (AC: 8) - Task 8: Add keyboard shortcuts for navigation (Optional enhancement) - Task 9: Write component tests for AI Generator page (Testing) - Task 10: Write integration tests for navigation flow (Testing)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. "AI Generator" button added next to Record button in sidebar 2. Button always visible/enabled (validation happens on action) 3. Clicking button opens dedicated AI Generator page/modal (separate from timeline) 4. Page contains tab navigation: History, Transcribe, Generate, Results 5. Tab system implemented with shadcn/ui Tabs component 6. Navigation between tabs maintains state within session 7. "Back to Editor" button returns to main timeline view 8. Layout responsive and matches dark theme

docs.doc: Defines AIGeneratorPage.tsx as main AI Generator page container with tab navigation state management.
Specifies component organization under src/renderer/src/components/AI/ with panel components for each tab.
Integrates with uiStore.ts for AI Generator page visibility and active tab state.

story-context.constraints: - Component Structure: AI Generator page is top-level route/page component that orchestrates panel components - State Management: Use uiStore.ts (Zustand) for page visibility, local component state for active tab - Tab System: Use shadcn/ui Tabs component for accessible tab navigation with keyboard support - Routing: Simple conditional rendering based on visibility state (no complex routing library needed) - Theme: Must match dark theme from existing UI with consistent typography and spacing - Component Location: All AI components under src/renderer/src/components/AI/ - Testing: Component tests for each panel, integration tests for navigation flow

interfaces.interface: Boolean flag to control AI Generator page visibility
Action to display AI Generator page and hide timeline
Action to hide AI Generator page and restore timeline view
Main container component with tab navigation and panel orchestration

tests.standards: Component tests use Vitest + React Testing Library. Tests located in __tests__ subdirectories with .test.tsx suffix. Follow existing test patterns from src/renderer/src/store/__tests__/. Test accessibility (keyboard navigation, ARIA attributes). Test dark theme styling consistency.
tests.ideas: - AC 1, 2: Test AI Generator button renders in Sidebar and is enabled - AC 3: Test clicking button calls showAIGenerator() and displays AIGeneratorPage - AC 4, 5: Test all four tabs render (History, Transcribe, Generate, Results) - AC 6: Test tab switching maintains content state (no data loss) - AC 7: Test "Back to Editor" button calls hideAIGenerator() and restores timeline - AC 8: Test dark theme classes applied, responsive layout on window resize - Integration: Test full flow (sidebar click → AI Generator opens → tabs switch → back to editor) - Accessibility: Test keyboard navigation (Tab, Arrow keys, Esc)
